title: On the deformation theory of chiral quantizations
summary: We give an operadic approach to deformation quantization of vertex Poisson algebras, a chiral analogue of the traditional problem of deformation quantization of Poisson algebras. Our main result is an order-by-order deformation-obstruction theory for such quantizations, controlled by the chiral analogue of Poisson cohomology. In the special case of chiral quantizations of affine symplectic varieties, quantizations of the vertex Poisson algebras of functions on their arc spaces, we prove that this deformation-obstruction theory is controlled by their de Rham cohomology.
